subject: CloudSmith marketplace + co-sell: evidence, SKUs, and launch milestones
messages:
From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@cloudsmith.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: CloudSmith marketplace + co-sell: initial intake

Hi Jasmine,

Great to meet at the summit last week. CloudSmith would love to get Redwood Inference listed in our marketplace and talk through a co-sell pairing. We see strong demand from our enterprise customers for hosted inference platforms with predictable SLAs and marketplace metering.

Quick asks to get started:
- Can you share the technical ingestion spec for marketplace listing (billing hooks / SKU mapping / usage metering)?
- Do you have a preliminary pricing floor or guided SKU definitions for a minimal listing?
- Who on your side should own the evidence binder (SOC2, security questionnaire, sample SLA language)?

I've attached our ingestion spec to speed the technical review (CloudSmith_Ingestion_Specs.pdf). Would you be available for a 30-min sync next week to align on milestones?

If helpful, I can pull in legal (Elena) and our GTM lead.

Thanks,
Sam Lewis
Head of Partnerships | CloudSmith
sam.lewis@cloudsmith.io
Attachments: CloudSmith_Ingestion_Specs.pdf
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@cloudsmith.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudSmith marketplace + co-sell: initial intake

Hi Sam — thanks, excited to get this moving.

We can absolutely do a listing + co-sell play. Preliminary responses below and a proposed intake plan:

Immediate owners:
- Technical intake & SKU mapping: Ben Carter (partner ops) — cc'd
- GTM & co-sell ops: Vivek Kulkarni — cc'd
- Evidence & security: Jasmine (myself) to coordinate with Security for SOC2 artifacts

What we need from CloudSmith:
- Confirm metering model (per-token vs per-instance) and whether you support nested SKUs for reserved capacity
- Any marketplace-specific SLA/credits language you require in the offer

Proposed next steps (30/60/90 plan):
1) Week 1: Technical sync (Ben + our runtime/infra lead) to map SKUs and billing hooks — target 4/19.
2) Week 2: Evidence handoff. We will share a curated evidence binder (SOC2 report, pen-tests, logging/audit screenshots).
3) Week 3: Draft co-sell MOU and mutual-action plan; finalize pricing bands for the listing.

I've attached our onboarding template to capture the required fields (Redwood_Marketplace_Onboarding_Template.xlsx). Can you confirm availability for Mon 4/19 10:00am PT for the technical sync?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com
Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Onboarding_Template.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudSmith marketplace + co-sell: technical & pricing alignment

Putting some thoughts here ahead of the 4/19 sync.

Key product & pricing items we need to lock before technical integration:
- SKU model: prefer two SKUs to start — "runtime-hour" (metered) + "reserved-tpu-month" (committed capacity). CloudSmith's ingestion spec will determine how granular we need SKU ids.
- Pricing bands: need guidance from CloudSmith on their margin expectations and whether they support marketplace discount stacks (publisher + marketplace + promo).
- Billing latency & reconciliation: our billing export cadence is hourly; we need to confirm CloudSmith can accept hourly usage and provide reconciliation reports for charges.

Action items for the meeting:
- Decide on initial SKU names and canonical IDs (Ben to propose).
- Agree on test webhook/data format and a staging tenant to validate metering.
- Legal: ask legal to prepare a one-page MOU for co-sell commitments (who brings leads, attribution windows, referral fees). Kimberly / Karthik can drive the contract side.

I'll prepare a starter SKU draft and a short test plan to validate metering during the sync.

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@cloudsmith.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Elena Marin <elena@cloudsmith.io>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudSmith marketplace + co-sell: technical & pricing alignment

Thanks for the quick turnaround team.

Per requested items: we support both per-token/per-call metering and hourly instance metering (we often map to publisher usage exports). We can accept hourly exports and provide reconciliation. Nested SKUs are supported but require an initial mapping file.

Link to our evidence & partner intake folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCsT-cloudsmith-evidence. That contains an example seller listing, our standard publisher MOU, and sample billing export format.

On pricing: our marketplace typically expects a publisher list price and a co-sell uplift band (5–20%), but we can be flexible depending on commitment levels. Elena (cc) can align on any legal questions.

Looking forward to the 4/19 technical sync. We'll have an engineer and our product-metering owner on the call.

—Sam

> Putting some thoughts here ahead of the 4/19 sync.
>

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@cloudsmith.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 16:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudSmith marketplace + co-sell: technical & pricing alignment — mutual action plan

Thanks Sam — appreciate the evidence folder and clarity on metering.

Recap / mutual action plan (agreed owners & dates):
- 2027-04-19: Technical sync (Ben + CloudSmith engineer) — validate hourly export and test webhook. Owner: Ben / Sam.
- 2027-04-23: SKU mapping file delivered by Redwood (Ben) — include canonical IDs and short descriptions.
- 2027-04-30: Evidence handoff by Redwood (Jasmine) — SOC2, pen-test summary, audit screenshots.
- 2027-05-07: Draft MOU and co-sell terms (Karthik / Elena) — legal to exchange a one-page MOU with basic attribution rules and uplift bands.
- 2027-05-14: Pilot listing live in CloudSmith staging with metering validated (Ben / CloudSmith).

I've attached a mutual_action_plan.docx and updated the onboarding template with our preferred SKU names. Please review and confirm any conflicts. If all good, let's lock 4/19 10:00am PT for the sync and I will send a calendar invite.

A couple of clarifying notes:
- We will start with conservative pricing bands for the pilot (publisher list price + 10% co-sell uplift) and surface performance-based adjustments after pilot telemetry.
- Attribution window: propose 30 days for lead attribution unless legal requests otherwise.

Sam — can you confirm attendees on your side for the 4/19 call so we can invite the appropriate Redwood engineers?

Best regards,
Jasmine Liu
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx
